title: Parentheticals · 要点精讲(第4轮)
summary: A parenthetical is inserted in the middle of a sentence such as I think / to be frank / believe it or not; the word order stays unchanged.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。
points: I think / I believe inserted in the middle
to be frank frankly speaking
believe it or not believe it or not
as a result / in fact
a parenthetical is separated from the sentence by commas

examples.en: This book, I think, is worth reading.
examples.zh: 这本书,我认为,值得一读。

examples.en: To be frank, the plan is too expensive.
examples.zh: 坦率地说,这个计划太贵了。

examples.en: Believe it or not, he finished it in an hour.
examples.zh: 信不信由你,他一小时内就完成了。

examples.en: The answer, in fact, is quite simple.
examples.zh: 答案,事实上,非常简单。

examples.en: He was late again, as a result, he missed the train.
examples.zh: 他又迟到了,结果错过了火车。

examples.en: This way, I believe, is much better.
examples.zh: 这种方法,我相信,要好得多。

questions.prompt: 「这本书,我认为,值得一读。」的正确英文是?
options: This book, I think, is worth reading.
This book, think I, is worth reading.
This book, do I think, is worth reading.
This book, I do think, is worth reading.
questions.explanation: 考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:This book, I think, is worth reading.

questions.prompt: _____, the plan is too expensive.
options: Frankly to
To be frank
To frank
Being frank
questions.explanation: 考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。此处应为 To be frank。句意:坦率地说,这个计划太贵了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Believed it or not, he finished it in an hour.
Believe it or not, he finished it in an hour.
Believe or not, he finished it in an hour.
Believing it or not, he finished it in an hour.
questions.explanation: Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:Believe it or not, he finished it in an hour.

questions.prompt: 「答案,事实上,非常简单。」的正确英文是?
options: The answer, at fact, is quite simple.
The answer, in fact, is quite simple.
The answer, in the fact, is quite simple.
The answer, on fact, is quite simple.
questions.explanation: 考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:The answer, in fact, is quite simple.

questions.prompt: He was late again, _____, he missed the train.
options: in result
as result
as a result
as a result of
questions.explanation: 考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。此处应为 as a result。句意:他又迟到了,结果错过了火车。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: This way, believe I, is much better.
This way, do I believe, is much better.
This way, I do believe, is much better.
This way, I believe, is much better.
questions.explanation: Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:This way, I believe, is much better.

title: Ellipsis in adverbial clauses · 要点精讲(第4轮)
summary: Ellipsis in adverbial clauses: when the subject is the same and be is present, omit 'subject + be', keeping only the conjunction + complement.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。
points: When (you are) in doubt, ask the teacher.
While (I was) reading, I fell asleep.
as if a child as if a child
if possible / if necessary are fixed ellipses
only when the subject is the same as the main clause can ellipsis occur

examples.en: When in trouble, ask your friends for help.
examples.zh: 遇到困难时,向朋友求助。

examples.en: While reading the book, I took many notes.
examples.zh: 读这本书时,我记了很多笔记。

examples.en: If necessary, I will come earlier.
examples.zh: 如果有必要,我会早点来。

examples.en: He stood as if rooted to the ground.
examples.zh: 他站在那里,像生了根一样。

examples.en: Unless invited, I won't go to the party.
examples.zh: 除非被邀请,否则我不会去参加聚会。

examples.en: Once printed, the report cannot be changed.
examples.zh: 报告一旦打印出来就不能改了。

questions.prompt: _____, ask your friends for help.
options: When being trouble
When are in trouble
When you in trouble
When in trouble
questions.explanation: 考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。此处应为 When in trouble。句意:遇到困难时,向朋友求助。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: While reading the book, I took many notes.
While was reading the book, I took many notes.
While read the book, I took many notes.
While I reading the book, I took many notes.
questions.explanation: When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:While reading the book, I took many notes.

questions.prompt: 「如果有必要,我会早点来。」的正确英文是?
options: If being necessary, I will come earlier.
If necessary, I will come earlier.
If is necessary, I will come earlier.
If it necessary, I will come earlier.
questions.explanation: 考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:If necessary, I will come earlier.

questions.prompt: He stood _____ to the ground.
options: as if rooting
as if root
as if rooted
as if was rooted
questions.explanation: 考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。此处应为 as if rooted。句意:他站在那里,像生了根一样。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Unless invite, I won't go to the party.
Unless inviting, I won't go to the party.
Unless am invited, I won't go to the party.
Unless invited, I won't go to the party.
questions.explanation: When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:Unless invited, I won't go to the party.

questions.prompt: 「报告一旦打印出来就不能改了。」的正确英文是?
options: Once print, the report cannot be changed.
Once printed, the report cannot be changed.
Once printing, the report cannot be changed.
Once is printed, the report cannot be changed.
questions.explanation: 考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:Once printed, the report cannot be changed.

title: Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact · 基础巩固(第4轮)
summary: Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact: the if clause uses the past, the main clause uses would/could/might + base verb.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。
points: if + past (be uniformly were)
main clause would/could/might + base verb
expresses a hypothesis contrary to present fact
were is used for all persons
if omitted, invert: Were I you, I would go

examples.en: If I were you, I would take the chance.
examples.zh: 如果我是你,我就会抓住这个机会。

examples.en: If he had more time, he would learn English.
examples.zh: 如果他有更多时间,他会学英语。

examples.en: If I were a bird, I could fly to Sydney.
examples.zh: 如果我是一只鸟,我就能飞到悉尼。

examples.en: If we started now, we would catch the train.
examples.zh: 如果我们现在出发,就能赶上火车。

examples.en: If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
examples.zh: 如果她知道答案,她会告诉我们。

examples.en: If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.
examples.zh: 如果没有钱,我就会买一台新电脑。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If I were you, I would take the chance.
If I was you, I would take the chance.
If I am you, I would take the chance.
If I would be you, I would take the chance.
questions.explanation: If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If I were you, I would take the chance.

questions.prompt: 「如果他有更多时间,他会学英语。」的正确英文是?
options: If he had more time, he will learn English.
If he had more time, he learned English.
If he had more time, he would learn English.
If he had more time, he would learned English.
questions.explanation: 考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If he had more time, he would learn English.

questions.prompt: If I were a bird, I _____ to Sydney.
options: can fly
will fly
could fly
could flew
questions.explanation: 考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。此处应为 could fly。句意:如果我是一只鸟,我就能飞到悉尼。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If we would start now, we would catch the train.
If we started now, we would catch the train.
If we will start now, we would catch the train.
If we start now, we would catch the train.
questions.explanation: If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If we started now, we would catch the train.

questions.prompt: 「如果她知道答案,她会告诉我们。」的正确英文是?
options: If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
If she knows the answer, she would tell us.
If she would know the answer, she would tell us.
If she has known the answer, she would tell us.
questions.explanation: 考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If she knew the answer, she would tell us.

questions.prompt: If I had the money, I _____ a new computer.
options: would bought
would buy
will buy
bought
questions.explanation: 考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。此处应为 would buy。句意:如果没有钱,我就会买一台新电脑。

title: Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact · 基础巩固(第4轮)
summary: Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would have + past participle.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。
points: if + had + past participle
main clause would/could have + past participle
expresses regret or hypothesis about the past
if omitted, invert: Had I known...
mixed with a present result: the main clause is still would + base verb

examples.en: If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
examples.zh: 如果我知道真相,我早就告诉你了。

examples.en: If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
examples.zh: 如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。

examples.en: If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.
examples.zh: 如果我们带了地图,就不会迷路了。

examples.en: If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
examples.zh: 如果她更努力学习,就能通过了。

examples.en: Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
examples.zh: 要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。

examples.en: If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
examples.zh: 如果没下雨,我们就出去了。

questions.prompt: 「如果我知道真相,我早就告诉你了。」的正确英文是?
options: If I knew the truth, I would have told you.
If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
If I have known the truth, I would have told you.
If I would know the truth, I would have told you.
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If I had known the truth, I would have told you.

questions.prompt: If he had left earlier, he _____ the train.
options: had caught
would have caught
will have caught
would catch
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 would have caught。句意:如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.
If we had taken a map, we hadn't got lost.
If we had taken a map, we won't get lost.
If we had taken a map, we wouldn't get lost.
questions.explanation: If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.

questions.prompt: 「如果她更努力学习,就能通过了。」的正确英文是?
options: If she had studied harder, she could pass.
If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
If she had studied harder, she had passed.
If she had studied harder, she can have passed.
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If she had studied harder, she could have passed.

questions.prompt: _____ you, I would have said hello.
options: Did I see
Had I seen
If I would see
Have I seen
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 Had I seen。句意:要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If it didn't rain, we would have gone out.
If it hasn't rained, we would have gone out.
If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
If it wouldn't rain, we would have gone out.
questions.explanation: If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.

title: Subjunctive mood after wish · 基础巩固(第4轮)
summary: The object clause after wish uses the subjunctive mood: past expresses a present wish, past perfect expresses past regret.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。
points: wish + subject + past (a present wish)
wish + subject + past perfect (a past regret)
wish + could/would + base verb (a future wish)
were is used for all persons
if only = how I wish

examples.en: I wish I had more free time.
examples.zh: 真希望我有更多空闲时间。

examples.en: She wishes she had studied harder before.
examples.zh: 她真希望以前更努力学习。

examples.en: I wish I were as tall as my brother.
examples.zh: 真希望我和哥哥一样高。

examples.en: He wishes he could fly a plane.
examples.zh: 他真希望自己会开飞机。

examples.en: If only I had taken your advice!
examples.zh: 要是我听了你的建议就好了!

examples.en: We wish we had visited London last year.
examples.zh: 真希望我们去年去了伦敦。

questions.prompt: I wish I _____ more free time.
options: had
have
would have
having
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 had。句意:真希望我有更多空闲时间。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She wishes she has studied harder before.
She wishes she would study harder before.
She wishes she studied harder before.
She wishes she had studied harder before.
questions.explanation: wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:She wishes she had studied harder before.

questions.prompt: 「真希望我和哥哥一样高。」的正确英文是?
options: I wish I was as tall as my brother.
I wish I were as tall as my brother.
I wish I am as tall as my brother.
I wish I will be as tall as my brother.
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:I wish I were as tall as my brother.

questions.prompt: He wishes he _____ a plane.
options: flew
can fly
could flew
could fly
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 could fly。句意:他真希望自己会开飞机。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If only I took your advice!
If only I had taken your advice!
If only I would take your advice!
If only I have taken your advice!
questions.explanation: wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:If only I had taken your advice!

questions.prompt: 「真希望我们去年去了伦敦。」的正确英文是?
options: We wish we would visit London last year.
We wish we visited London last year.
We wish we have visited London last year.
We wish we had visited London last year.
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:We wish we had visited London last year.

title: Subjunctive mood after suggest / insist · 基础巩固(第4轮)
summary: After suggest, insist, demand, order, the object clause uses (should) + base verb.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。
points: suggest/insist/demand/order + (should) + base verb
should can be omitted
the negative is (should) not + base verb
the corresponding noun/adjective also take the base form
insist on 'insisting on a fact' takes the normal tense

examples.en: The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
examples.zh: 医生建议他多锻炼。

examples.en: She insisted that we be there on time.
examples.zh: 她坚持要我们准时到。

examples.en: The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.
examples.zh: 老师要求今天交作业。

examples.en: It is important that everyone follow the rules.
examples.zh: 每个人都遵守规则很重要。

examples.en: He ordered that the work be finished at once.
examples.zh: 他命令立刻完成工作。

examples.en: My mother suggested that I not watch too much TV.
examples.zh: 我妈妈建议我不要看太多电视。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: The doctor suggested that he taking more exercise.
The doctor suggested that he takes more exercise.
The doctor suggested that he took more exercise.
The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
questions.explanation: Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.

questions.prompt: 「她坚持要我们准时到。」的正确英文是?
options: She insisted that we being there on time.
She insisted that we be there on time.
She insisted that we were there on time.
She insisted that we are there on time.
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:She insisted that we be there on time.

questions.prompt: The teacher demanded that the homework _____ in today.
options: is handed
been handed
be handed
was handed
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 be handed。句意:老师要求今天交作业。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: It is important that everyone follow the rules.
It is important that everyone following the rules.
It is important that everyone follows the rules.
It is important that everyone followed the rules.
questions.explanation: Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:It is important that everyone follow the rules.

questions.prompt: 「他命令立刻完成工作。」的正确英文是?
options: He ordered that the work be finished at once.
He ordered that the work was finished at once.
He ordered that the work been finished at once.
He ordered that the work is finished at once.
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:He ordered that the work be finished at once.

questions.prompt: My mother suggested that I _____ too much TV.
options: not watch
didn't watch
not to watch
not watching
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 not watch。句意:我妈妈建议我不要看太多电视。

title: Mixed subjunctive moods · 基础巩固(第4轮)
summary: Mixed subjunctive moods: the time referenced by the if clause differs from the main clause; choose the tense separately.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。
points: past condition + present result
if + had done, main clause would do
present condition + past result is rare
judge the time by the context
were/was, had, should trigger inversion when if is omitted

examples.en: If I had taken that job, I would be in Sydney now.
examples.zh: 如果我当时接受那份工作,我现在就在悉尼了。

examples.en: If he hadn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
examples.zh: 如果他没错过公交车,他现在就在这里了。

examples.en: If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
examples.zh: 如果我更聪明,昨天就把它解出来了。

examples.en: Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
examples.zh: 如果你那时问我,我现在也会帮你。

examples.en: If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't be tired now.
examples.zh: 如果她早点睡,现在就不会累了。

examples.en: If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.
examples.zh: 如果我那时攒了钱,今天就能买了。

questions.prompt: 「如果我当时接受那份工作,我现在就在悉尼了。」的正确英文是?
options: If I had taken that job, I would be in Sydney now.
If I had taken that job, I had been in Sydney now.
If I had taken that job, I would have been in Sydney now.
If I had taken that job, I will be in Sydney now.
questions.explanation: 考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I had taken that job, I would be in Sydney now.

questions.prompt: If he _____ the bus, he would be here now.
options: wouldn't miss
didn't miss
hadn't missed
hasn't missed
questions.explanation: 考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。此处应为 hadn't missed。句意:如果他没错过公交车,他现在就在这里了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
If I was smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
If I would be smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
If I had been smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
questions.explanation: A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.

questions.prompt: 「如果你那时问我,我现在也会帮你。」的正确英文是?
options: Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
Did you ask me then, I would help you even now.
If you would ask me then, I would help you even now.
Have you asked me then, I would help you even now.
questions.explanation: 考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.

questions.prompt: If she had gone to bed early, she _____ tired now.
options: won't be
wouldn't have been
hadn't been
wouldn't be
questions.explanation: 考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。此处应为 wouldn't be。句意:如果她早点睡,现在就不会累了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If I had saved money then, I had bought it today.
If I had saved money then, I can buy it today.
If I had saved money then, I could have bought it today.
If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.
questions.explanation: A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.

title: Inversion with fronted negative words · 基础巩固(第4轮)
summary: Negative or semi-negative adverbs at the start of a sentence require partial inversion.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。
points: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
Hardly had I arrived when it began to rain.
Not only did we lose, but we also got hurt.
Little did he know the truth.
the negative adverb determines the use of the auxiliary

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
examples.zh: 我从未见过这么美的日落。

examples.en: Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
examples.zh: 我们刚出发就开始下雨了。

examples.en: Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
examples.zh: 他不仅工作努力,还很善良。

examples.en: Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
examples.zh: 她一点也不知道答案是错的。

examples.en: Not once has he been late this year.
examples.zh: 今年他一次也没迟到过。

examples.en: Seldom do we see such old buildings now.
examples.zh: 我们现在很少见到这么老的建筑了。

questions.prompt: Never _____ such a beautiful sunset.
options: I saw
I have seen
have I seen
did I saw
questions.explanation: 考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 have I seen。句意:我从未见过这么美的日落。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Hardly we had started when it began to rain.
Hardly we started when it began to rain.

questions.explanation: If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.

title: Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact · 典型例句(第4轮)
summary: Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would have + past participle.本课为典型例句练习,核心:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。
points: if + had + past participle
main clause would/could have + past participle
expresses regret or hypothesis about the past
if omitted, invert: Had I known...
mixed with a present result: the main clause is still would + base verb

examples.en: If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
examples.zh: 如果我知道真相,我早就告诉你了。

examples.en: If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.

examples.en: If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
examples.zh: 如果她更努力学习,就能通过了。

examples.en: Had I seen you, I would have said hello.

examples.en: If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.

questions.prompt: If I _____ the truth, I would have told you.

have known
knew
would know
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 had known。句意:如果我知道真相,我早就告诉你了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If he had left earlier, he will have caught the train.

If he had left earlier, he would catch the train.

questions.explanation: If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.

questions.prompt: 「如果我们带了地图,就不会迷路了。」的正确英文是?
options: If we had taken a map, we hadn't got lost.
If we had taken a map, we won't get lost.
If we had taken a map, we wouldn't get lost.

could pass

Did I see you, I would have said hello.
questions.explanation: If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:Had I seen you, I would have said hello.

questions.prompt: 「如果没下雨,我们就出去了。」的正确英文是?
options: If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
If it wouldn't rain, we would have gone out.
If it hasn't rained, we would have gone out.
If it didn't rain, we would have gone out.
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.

title: Subjunctive mood after wish · 典型例句(第4轮)
summary: The object clause after wish uses the subjunctive mood: past expresses a present wish, past perfect expresses past regret.本课为典型例句练习,核心:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。
points: wish + subject + past (a present wish)
wish + subject + past perfect (a past regret)
wish + could/would + base verb (a future wish)
were is used for all persons
if only = how I wish

examples.en: I wish I had more free time.

examples.en: She wishes she had studied harder before.
examples.zh: 她真希望以前更努力学习。

examples.en: I wish I were as tall as my brother.

examples.en: He wishes he could fly a plane.
examples.zh: 他真希望自己会开飞机。

examples.en: If only I had taken your advice!
examples.zh: 要是我听了你的建议就好了!

examples.en: We wish we had visited London last year.
examples.zh: 真希望我们去年去了伦敦。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: I wish I have more free time.

I wish I would have more free time.

questions.explanation: wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:I wish I had more free time.

questions.prompt: 「她真希望以前更努力学习。」的正确英文是?
options: She wishes she studied harder before.
She wishes she has studied harder before.
She wishes she would study harder before.
She wishes she had studied harder before.
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:She wishes she had studied harder before.

questions.prompt: I wish I _____ as tall as my brother.
options: was
am
were
will be
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 were。句意:真希望我和哥哥一样高。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He wishes he could fly a plane.
He wishes he could flew a plane.
He wishes he can fly a plane.
He wishes he flew a plane.
questions.explanation: wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:He wishes he could fly a plane.

questions.prompt: 「要是我听了你的建议就好了!」的正确英文是?
options: If only I took your advice!
If only I had taken your advice!

questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:If only I had taken your advice!

questions.prompt: We wish we _____ London last year.
options: have visited
would visit
had visited
visited
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 had visited。句意:真希望我们去年去了伦敦。

title: Subjunctive mood after suggest / insist · 典型例句(第4轮)
summary: After suggest, insist, demand, order, the object clause uses (should) + base verb.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。
points: suggest/insist/demand/order + (should) + base verb
should can be omitted
the negative is (should) not + base verb
the corresponding noun/adjective also take the base form
insist on 'insisting on a fact' takes the normal tense

examples.en: The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
examples.zh: 医生建议他多锻炼。

examples.en: She insisted that we be there on time.
examples.zh: 她坚持要我们准时到。

examples.zh: 他命令立刻完成工作。

examples.zh: 我妈妈建议我不要看太多电视。

questions.prompt: 「医生建议他多锻炼。」的正确英文是?
options: The doctor suggested that he took more exercise.
The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
The doctor suggested that he taking more exercise.

questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.

questions.prompt: She insisted that we _____ there on time.
options: be
being
were
are
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 be。句意:她坚持要我们准时到。

The teacher demanded that the homework was handed in today.
questions.explanation: Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.

questions.prompt: 「每个人都遵守规则很重要。」的正确英文是?
options: It is important that everyone following the rules.

It is important that everyone follow the rules.
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:It is important that everyone follow the rules.

questions.prompt: He ordered that the work _____ at once.
options: is finished

be finished

questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 be finished。句意:他命令立刻完成工作。

title: Mixed subjunctive moods · 典型例句(第4轮)
summary: Mixed subjunctive moods: the time referenced by the if clause differs from the main clause; choose the tense separately.本课为典型例句练习,核心:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。
points: past condition + present result

present condition + past result is rare
judge the time by the context
were/was, had, should trigger inversion when if is omitted

examples.en: If I had taken that job, I would be in Paris now.
examples.zh: 如果我当时接受那份工作,我现在就在巴黎了。

title: Inversion with fronted negative words · 典型例句(第4轮)

questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:You won't give up, and neither shall we.

title: Appositives · 典型例句(第4轮)
summary: An appositive further explains the preceding noun and can be a word, phrase or clause.本课为典型例句练习,核心:A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。
points: Tom, my best friend, ...
a noun of identity directly follows
the appositive clause that explains an abstract noun: the news that ...
that in the appositive clause has no meaning and cannot be omitted
an appositive can be introduced by namely

examples.en: Mr. Wang, our English teacher, is very humorous.
examples.zh: 我们的英语老师王先生非常幽默。

examples.zh: 我们队获胜的消息让我们兴奋。

examples.zh: 我们只有一个目标,即获胜。

examples.zh: 他撒谎的事实让所有人吃惊。

examples.en: Beijing, the capital of China, is a big city.
examples.zh: 北京,中国的首都,是一座大城市。

examples.en: My friend Lily lives near the library.
examples.zh: 我的朋友莉莉住在图书馆附近。

questions.prompt: Mr. Wang, _____, is very humorous.

We have one goal, namely to win.
questions.explanation: 考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:We have one goal, namely to win.

questions.prompt: The fact _____ he lied surprised everyone.

that
whom
which
questions.explanation: 考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。此处应为 that。句意:他撒谎的事实让所有人吃惊。

options: Beijing, it the capital, is a big city.

questions.explanation: A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:Beijing, the capital of China, is a big city.

questions.explanation: 考查A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。正确句:My friend Lily lives near the library.

title: Parentheticals · 典型例句(第4轮)
summary: A parenthetical is inserted in the middle of a sentence such as I think / to be frank / believe it or not; the word order stays unchanged.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。
points: I think / I believe inserted in the middle
to be frank frankly speaking
believe it or not believe it or not
as a result / in fact
a parenthetical is separated from the sentence by commas

examples.en: This book, I think, is worth reading.
examples.zh: 这本书,我认为,值得一读。

examples.en: To be frank, the plan is too expensive.
examples.zh: 坦率地说,这个计划太贵了。

examples.en: Believe it or not, he finished it in an hour.
examples.zh: 信不信由你,他一小时内就完成了。

examples.en: The answer, in fact, is quite simple.
examples.zh: 答案,事实上,非常简单。

examples.en: He was late again, as a result, he missed the train.
examples.zh: 他又迟到了,结果错过了火车。

examples.en: This way, I believe, is much better.
examples.zh: 这种方法,我相信,要好得多。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: This book, do I think, is worth reading.
This book, think I, is worth reading.
This book, I do think, is worth reading.
This book, I think, is worth reading.
questions.explanation: Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:This book, I think, is worth reading.

questions.prompt: 「坦率地说,这个计划太贵了。」的正确英文是?
options: To be frank, the plan is too expensive.

To frank, the plan is too expensive.
questions.explanation: 考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:To be frank, the plan is too expensive.

questions.prompt: _____, he finished it in an hour.
options: Believe or not
Believe it or not
Believing it or not
Believed it or not
questions.explanation: 考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。此处应为 Believe it or not。句意:信不信由你,他一小时内就完成了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: The answer, at fact, is quite simple.

questions.explanation: Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:The answer, in fact, is quite simple.

questions.prompt: 「他又迟到了,结果错过了火车。」的正确英文是?

He was late again, in result, he missed the train.
questions.explanation: 考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。正确句:He was late again, as a result, he missed the train.

questions.prompt: This way, _____, is much better.
options: I believe

questions.explanation: 考查Insert a component explaining attitude or source; it does not affect the sentence's grammar。此处应为 I believe。句意:这种方法,我相信,要好得多。

title: Ellipsis in adverbial clauses · 典型例句(第4轮)
summary: Ellipsis in adverbial clauses: when the subject is the same and be is present, omit 'subject + be', keeping only the conjunction + complement.本课为典型例句练习,核心:When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。
points: When (you are) in doubt, ask the teacher.
While (I was) reading, I fell asleep.
as if a child as if a child
if possible / if necessary are fixed ellipses
only when the subject is the same as the main clause can ellipsis occur

examples.en: When in trouble, ask your friends for help.
examples.zh: 遇到困难时,向朋友求助。

examples.en: While reading the book, I took many notes.
examples.zh: 读这本书时,我记了很多笔记。

examples.en: If necessary, I will come earlier.
examples.zh: 如果有必要,我会早点来。

examples.en: He stood as if rooted to the ground.
examples.zh: 他站在那里,像生了根一样。

examples.en: Unless invited, I won't go to the party.
examples.zh: 除非被邀请,否则我不会去参加聚会。

examples.zh: 报告一旦打印出来就不能改了。

When you in trouble, ask your friends for help.
When in trouble, ask your friends for help.
questions.explanation: 考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:When in trouble, ask your friends for help.

questions.prompt: _____ the book, I took many notes.
options: While reading
While read

While was reading
questions.explanation: 考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。此处应为 While reading。句意:读这本书时,我记了很多笔记。

options: He stood as if root to the ground.

He stood as if rooting to the ground.
questions.explanation: 考查When the subject of the subordinate clause is the same as the main clause and contains be, omit the subject and be。正确句:He stood as if rooted to the ground.

title: Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact: the if clause uses the past, the main clause uses would/could/might + base verb.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。
points: if + past (be uniformly were)
main clause would/could/might + base verb
expresses a hypothesis contrary to present fact
were is used for all persons
if omitted, invert: Were I you, I would go

examples.zh: 如果我是你,我就会抓住这个机会。

examples.en: If he had more time, he would learn math.
examples.zh: 如果他有更多时间,他会学数学。

examples.en: If I were a bird, I could fly to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 如果我是一只鸟,我就能飞到东京。

examples.en: If we started now, we would catch the train.
examples.zh: 如果我们现在出发,就能赶上火车。

examples.en: If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
examples.zh: 如果她知道答案,她会告诉我们。

am
would be
was

options: If he had more time, he learned math.

questions.explanation: If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If he had more time, he would learn math.

questions.explanation: 考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If I were a bird, I could fly to Tokyo.

will start
started

questions.explanation: If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If she knew the answer, she would tell us.

If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.
If I had the money, I bought a new computer.
questions.explanation: 考查If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。正确句:If I had the money, I would buy a new computer.

title: Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact · 易错辨析(第4轮)
summary: Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would have + past participle.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。
points: if + had + past participle
main clause would/could have + past participle
expresses regret or hypothesis about the past
if omitted, invert: Had I known...
mixed with a present result: the main clause is still would + base verb

examples.en: If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.

options: If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
If I have known the truth, I would have told you.

If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
If she had studied harder, she could pass.
questions.explanation: If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If she had studied harder, she could have passed.

If I would see you, I would have said hello.
Have I seen you, I would have said hello.
Did I see you, I would have said hello.
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:Had I seen you, I would have said hello.

questions.prompt: If it _____, we would have gone out.
options: wouldn't rain
hadn't rained
hasn't rained
didn't rain
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 hadn't rained。句意:如果没下雨,我们就出去了。

questions.prompt: 「真希望我有更多空闲时间。」的正确英文是?

He wishes he could fly a plane.
He wishes he could flew a plane.
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:He wishes he could fly a plane.

questions.prompt: If only I _____ your advice!
options: would take
have taken
had taken
took
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 had taken。句意:要是我听了你的建议就好了!

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We wish we had visited Paris last year.
We wish we would visit Paris last year.
We wish we visited Paris last year.
We wish we have visited Paris last year.
questions.explanation: wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:We wish we had visited Paris last year.

take

questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.

followed

follow

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?

title: Formal subject it · 情景运用(第4轮)

title: Subjunctive mood after wish · 专项练习(第4轮)
summary: The object clause after wish uses the subjunctive mood: past expresses a present wish, past perfect expresses past regret.本课为专项练习练习,核心:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。
points: wish + subject + past (a present wish)
wish + subject + past perfect (a past regret)
